name: KEYNOTE SPEECH
description: To introduce the conference's theme, set the tone (outlining the main message or theme) for the event, and inspire and engage the audience (sparking their interest and encouraging active participation in the conference activities).

name: PARALLEL TALK
description: Also known as parallel sessions, refers to multiple presentations or discussions happening simultaneously in different rooms or venues. This format allows attendees to choose sessions that align with their specific interests and attend multiple sessions throughout the day.

name: PLANERY SESSION
description: A meeting where all attendees are present, typically used for keynotes, general discussions, and important announcements. It's a format that brings everyone together to share information, make decisions, and foster a sense of community.

name: LEADERSHIP DIALOGUE
description: A conference setting is a facilitated discussion focused on exploring leadership topics, sharing perspectives, and fostering collective reflection among participants.

name: WORKSHOP AND ROUNDTABLE DISCUSSION
description: To introduce the conference's theme, set the tone (outlining the main message or theme) for the event, and inspire and engage the audience (sparking their interest and encouraging active participation in the conference activities).

name: PAPER PRESENTATION
description: Parallel presentations where delegates present their projects or event proposal.

name: TED TALK
description: A Talk by famous figure with the goals to spark interest and awareness in public in volunterism.

name: GRANT PRESENTATION
description: A special pitching session between selected delegates and NGOs or funding agency for sponsorship or securing grant.

name: EXHIBITION AND NETWORKING SESSION
description: Poster Exhibition by MPU4, DTE Projects and Booth Exhibition by NGOs and Collaborators.
